name: request_team
description: Proposes to the user that a predefined collaborative team (e.g. 'dev_ops', 'dev_security', 'cyber_audit', 'story_comedy') be convened to carry out a specific task as a group. Requires the user's explicit approval.

team_name.description: The name of the predefined team to convene (e.g. 'dev_security', 'dev_ops', 'tech_docs', 'creative_promo'). Optional: if omitted, the user is asked.

task.description: A clear description of the task to assign to the team.

reason.description: A clear rationale for why activating this specific team is advisable.
